verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant work inside the workspace from natural-language prompts such as "What evidence requests are still outstanding on this audit?" It supports listing audits and evidence requests and adding comments, attachments and status updates. Two things limit this: the natural-language layer is an external assistant connected over MCP, and the documented operations cover only audits and evidence requests. The in-app AI Helpbot only answers documentation questions and cannot operate the product. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command execution, documented coverage beyond audits and evidence requests (e.g. controls, risks, policies, access reviews), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: MCP lets the assistant work directly inside your Thoropass workspace, within limits you set.
"What evidence requests are still outstanding on this audit?"
Add comments, attachments, and status updates to evidence requests
List audits and view audit details ... List evidence requests, view their details, and see the systems tied to them
